## What this changes

One or two sentences.

## Definition of done

- [ ] Does exactly one increment, nothing extra
- [ ] Pure logic lives in `core` and imports nothing from the browser
- [ ] New or updated automated test that would fail without this change
- [ ] Boundary cases covered
- [ ] All local gates pass: lint, typecheck, test, build, format:check, e2e
- [ ] STATE.md and ROADMAP.md updated
- [ ] LEARNING.md has the plain English note
- [ ] No commented out code, no TODO without a linked issue
- [ ] Manual test script updated if the change affects it
- [ ] Screenshot or short clip attached if the change is visible
